newsitem.title: USA: Fingerhut completes over $1 bln financing.
newsitem.headline: Fingerhut completes over $1 bln financing.

text.p: Fingerhut Cos Inc said on Wednesday that it recently completed four financing transactions totaling more than $1 billion.

It said the transactions will enable it to finance the future growth of the direct-to-the-consumer marketing company and its subsidiaries, including Metris Cos Inc and to refinance certain long-term debt on more favorable terms.
Fingerhut said on September 27 that it completed the private placement of $125 million of three-year notes. The offering was priced at 102.5 basis points over the three-year treasury note.
On September 16, it closed a $200 million, five-year revolving credit facility for Fingerhut Cos Inc and a $300 million five-year revolving credit facility for Metris, guaranteed by Fingerhut.
Also on September 16, it closed a $400 million increase to the Fingerhut Owner Trust asset-backed commercial paper program. This increased the size of the commercial paper program to $1.2 billion.
It said additional asset-backed certificates of $112.4 million were issued to support the increase in the asset-backed commercial paper program.
